After restoring, the working-tree diff is byte-identical to the saved B4-i18n.diff.

The fix follows the CLAUDE.md rule "Never build a user-facing sentence inside a wire type; emit structure and let the localized view render it". Core/Models/VendorNotice.swift adds two closed enums, VendorDisclaimer and VendorGuidance (Sendable, Codable, CaseIterable), with no [String: Any]. The App maps them to localized text in one place, App/Localization/VendorNoticeText.swift:38-68, and the switches are exhaustive with no default. So a new case fails to compile until it has a key, and VendorNoticeLocalizationTests.keys_exist_in_every_language checks that every key exists in en, pt-BR and es. AppError gains a single computed httpStatus (AppError.swift:41-58). isTransient, isRateLimited and isUnauthorized now read from it, which removes two `if case .http` pattern matches instead of adding a third. No error is swallowed: every throw site in AntigravityExecutor.swift, GeminiProvider.swift and XAIProvider.swift still throws, now as .guidance. CachedFetch.swift:54-58 keeps the status through `appErr.httpStatus ?? 0`; that is not a silent default, because the old code already used 0 there. New tests use expectTrue for optional conditions, as the Testing policy requires (e.g. GeminiXAILocaleNeutralTests `snap?.isAntigravityActive == true`). The two test names made stale by the fix were renamed (GeminiProviderTests `...throws antigravityNotFound guidance`, `...into structured guidance`). README and all three Localizable.strings were updated together. The report records validate exit 0 with 0 warnings; I did not rebuild, per the read-only protocol.

Every touched file ties to the finding. Portuguese prose was removed from Providers: GeminiWireTypes.swift:57,71,199, XAIWireTypes.swift:251,302,403, GeminiProvider.swift:80, XAIProvider.swift:117 and AntigravityExecutor.swift:57-166. The App now renders it through VendorNoticeText.swift, and VendorSectionView.swift:360,660,729 changed only at the Text() call sites. The contract change from disclaimer String? to VendorDisclaimer? (UsageSnapshot.swift:492,565,607) needs no migration. VendorSnapshot/GeminiSnapshot/XAISnapshot are never persisted: the only encoder.encode of a snapshot is in tests (GoldenSnapshotTests.swift:280, SnapshotModelTests.swift:79). DiskCache stores the raw vendor bytes and decodes them again, so no old on-disk data carries the Portuguese string. The removed public API (GrokBillingResponse.defaultDisclaimer, toSnapshot(disclaimer:)) has no remaining callers in Sources or Tests. The new AppError.guidance case keeps the behavior at the edges: AppError.httpStatus maps it to 401/503, VendorViewModel.needsReauth reads isUnauthorized, CachedFetch.swift:57 keeps the status in FetchError, and observeRateLimit only acts on 429, which guidance never produces. All 3 Localizable.strings have the same key set (339 = 339 = 339, diff empty), with real es/pt-BR translations for the 5 new guidance_* keys. README.md:282,311 are updated, AiTaskbarValidate/main.swift:156,284,297 were migrated to the enum, and grep finds no leftover Portuguese in Sources/*.swift.
